title: Secure an S3 Bucket
description: Write a bucket policy and configure encryption for a corporate data repository.
problemStatement:
Your company wants to store sensitive financial reports in an S3 bucket named `fin-reports-2025`. Write a bucket policy (JSON) that:
- Allows the IAM role `FinanceAppRole` to upload and read objects.
- Denies any public access (explicit deny for `s3:GetObject` with `Principal: *`).
- Forces all objects to be encrypted with SSE‑KMS using a specific KMS key ARN `arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-1234` (via a `Deny` for non‑encrypted uploads).

Additionally, describe the steps to enable default encryption on the bucket to AES‑256 (SSE‑S3) as a fallback.
hints: Use an explicit deny to block public access (this is separate from Block Public Access).
The force‑encryption condition uses `s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption` header check.
Default encryption is set in bucket properties.
expectedOutput: A bucket policy JSON and a short description.
